description:
Wire egui UI controls to issue user actions through the existing `cli_outbound` module (ARCH §3.4 / §3.5: user actions are exclusively `lernie <subcommand>` invocations).

=== Scope ===

Two buttons, both invoked through `cli_outbound::run`:

- **New prompt.** Text input + submit, invokes `lernie prompt <repo> <message>` (current CLI surface; argument shape per `src/bin/lernie.rs`). Exact subcommand string is read from the live binary, not coined here.
- **Stop.** Targets a selected unmerged branch, invokes `lernie stop <repo> <branch>` (CLI shape pinned by bl-a144).

Resume was excised from v0.5 by bl-abf3 (architecture amendment); no resume button.

=== Rules ===

- No persistent UI state (§3.5). Selection lives in memory; everything reproducible from filesystem.
- All commands go through `cli_outbound::run`; no direct `Command::new` in the UI module.
- Disabled-button states derive from view-model: Stop disabled when no in-flight branch is selected; New prompt disabled when input is empty.

=== Tests ===

- View-model unit: button enabled/disabled bits derive correctly from fixture repos (in-flight selection, empty input, etc.).
- Integration: a fake `lernie` on PATH (shell stub, no mocking) records its argv; clicking each button produces the expected argv shape (`lernie prompt <repo> <text>` / `lernie stop <repo> <branch>`).

=== Dependencies ===

- **bl-a144** — `lernie stop` subcommand must exist and have a pinned CLI shape before this ball is claimable; otherwise the integration test would assert against a moving target.
- **bl-abf3** — ARCH amendment excising user-action resume must land first so v0.5 done-when, §2.9, §3.4 are consistent before this ball wires its buttons.

=== Gates ===

Tests, docs, alignment per AGENTS.md.
title: UI: user-action buttons wired through cli_outbound (new prompt / stop)
